`diff`, `up` and `export`: version, image and backup settings
`backup.bucket` alone (`backup-bucket`); F8: memory, shm-size, custom-env, config-options, networks, restart-policy, log options, expose
F8 (low: its ambassador container breaks on Docker 29)
Data operation: can need a dump and downtime, so `diff` shows a changed `version`/`image` and `up` warns (F2)
`postgres.<name>.backup.auth`, when `backup-auth-fingerprint`, region, signature version or endpoint differ
`backup: false`, when a schedule is installed
